Prime-power existence follows from distinct linear forms. Independent finite verifiers check every small-field pair and concrete first-failing sets; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The result determines the sharp universal adversarial vertex-deletion budget preserving a natural finite-model-theoretic invariant for every orthogonal-array graph, with an attained quadratic-order optimum, exact parity phase, and unique maximizing row counts. This is a motivated fault-resilience classification of structured finite approximations to the random graph, not an arbitrary unmotivated finite slice. It makes no claim of novelty for the standard SRG parameters or basic multiplicity lemma.
